'''The Sundered Veil''' was a location in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> that constituted a part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> After its restoration around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] moved aggressively beyond the Republic's frontier to defend its [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] and commerce. Although few records survived from that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Music/Legends|songs]] continued to mention deeds of bravery committed by members of the Republic Navy during conflicts at the celestial bodies [[Esaga]] and [[Caulbon]] as well as the Sundered Veil. During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of time lasting from approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] to [[11,000 BBY]], the Sundered Veil was situated on the Republic's border.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sundered Veil was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square S-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
